newsitem.title: JAPAN: India tenders to buy December crude--traders.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy December crude--traders.

text.p: The Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has tendered to buy one million barrels of crude oil for December, traders said on Wednesday.
The tender, which is for a wide variety of crudes including Middle Eastern, Asian, African and North Sea, closes at 6 p.m. (1230 GMT) in New Delhi on October 17, they said.
Offers should be valid until 10 p.m. (1630 GMT) on October 18, the tender said.
The IOC bought four cargoes of Dubai crude and three very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Qua Iboe crude in its November purchase tender.
